TASK: Add a headless client binary and p50/p99 latency instrumentation to the erd-app crate.

Work in /Users/indo/code/project/EclipticRD-Rewrite/clients/rust (cargo workspace, crates erd-proto erd-net erd-decode erd-render erd-app erd-host, all tests currently green). Performance is the absolute top priority — zero-compromise.

DELIVERABLE:
Two additions to the erd-app crate ONLY (do not touch other crates except erd-app/Cargo.toml for the bin target):

1. Latency instrumentation module `erd-app/src/latency.rs` (export from lib.rs):
   - Struct `LatencyRecorder` ingesting per-frame samples: capture_ts (from frame header if present, else receive Instant), decode_ts, present_ts. Compute p50/p95/p99/max in microseconds; prefer a fixed-capacity ring buffer (performance matters), std only.
   - `stats_json() -> String` emitting {"frames":N,"p50_us":...,"p95_us":...,"p99_us":...,"max_us":...}.
   - Unit tests: empty, single, synthetic 1000-sample distribution sanity (p50 <= p95 <= p99 <= max).

2. Headless client binary `[[bin]] name = "erd-client"` in erd-app (src/bin/erd_client.rs) for VM E2E:
   - clap args: --host <ip>, --tcp-port (default 49152), --udp-port, --pin <8digit bootstrap PIN>, --psk-hex <64 hex> fallback when no pairing store, --frames <N> (exit 0 after decoding N video frames), --stats-json <path>, --timeout-secs (default 30).
   - Reuse erd-app lib APIs (pairing.rs, session.rs) — READ THEM FIRST and wire the REAL flow: pair via signaling with PIN, TCP TLS-PSK handshake v3, UDP media receive + decode via erd-decode, count decoded frames, record latency samples per frame via LatencyRecorder, clean teardown (close both transports), exit 0; non-zero exit on failure with error on stderr.
   - Headless only: no winit/wgpu window; decoding counter is enough.

SCOPE: erd-app crate only; no Sources/ changes (Swift frozen); no git commit; no new heavy deps (clap/serde/anyhow already in tree).

VERIFY: `cargo test -p erd-app` green incl. new latency tests; `cargo build -p erd-app --bins` success; `cargo clippy -p erd-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` zero warnings. Include command outputs in your report.

STOP WHEN: all three verification commands pass and the report contains their outputs.

TASK: Scaffold a Tauri 2 desktop shell embedding the erd-app client-core library.

Work in /Users/indo/code/project/EclipticRD-Rewrite/clients/rust (cargo workspace).

DELIVERABLE: `clients/rust/tauri-shell/` added as a workspace member (APPEND "tauri-shell" to the members array in clients/rust/Cargo.toml — do not reorder or remove existing entries):
- src-tauri/ per Tauri 2 convention: src-tauri/Cargo.toml (tauri 2, tauri-build 2; lib + bin), src-tauri/tauri.conf.json (productName EclipticRD, identifier com.eclipticrd.shell, window 1280x800), src-tauri/ui/index.html minimal static UI (plain HTML+JS calling Tauri invoke; no node frontend).
- Tauri commands: connect(host, tcp_port, udp_port, pin) starting an erd-app session in a tokio task; disconnect(); stats() returning frames decoded + latency p50/p99 if available; send_input proxied to erd-app input pipeline.
- READ erd-app/src/lib.rs and session.rs first; embed the REAL types via the thinnest adapter.
- Media pipeline on a separate thread/task; never block the main thread.

SCOPE: tauri-shell crate + one-line members addition; no other crates; no Sources/ changes; no git commit. Use CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target-tauri for ALL cargo commands in this node (never contend on the shared workspace target dir). Do NOT run tauri build (no bundling).

VERIFY: `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target-tauri cargo check -p tauri-shell` exit 0.

STOP WHEN: cargo check passes and members list keeps all six existing crates plus tauri-shell.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Create and actually RUN the tart VM interop E2E and latency benchmark until they PASS.

Work in /Users/indo/code/project/EclipticRD-Rewrite. Performance measurement is the absolute priority (p50/p99 frame latency, Moonlight comparison). PREREQUISITE: node R1 added the erd-client binary to clients/rust/erd-app — wait for it (check `ls clients/rust/erd-app/src/bin/erd_client.rs` and that `cargo build -p erd-app --bins` succeeds); if absent re-check every 60s up to 30 min then fail.

Environment: tart VM 'eclipticrd-ci' at 192.168.64.197 (macOS 15.7.7). SSH: `ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 admin@192.168.64.197` (passwordless sudo). Verify rust toolchain in VM first (`ssh ... 'which cargo || ls ~/.cargo/bin'`); install via rustup if missing.

DELIVERABLE:
1. `scripts/vm-interop.sh` — real-session E2E IN THE VM ONLY (project rule: E2E never runs on the physical host):
   - rsync clients/rust to VM:~/erd (exclude target dirs),
   - on VM: cargo build -p erd-host --features macos-host --bins -p erd-app --bins (debug first for iteration),
   - read erd-host/src/main.rs first for exact CLI flags; start erd-host headless with --bootstrap-pin 12345678; if SCK capture is permission-blocked in the VM use its synthetic/test capture mode if one exists (grep erd-host/src for synthetic/test capture) and document the choice,
   - run erd-client on the VM against it: pair with PIN, handshake, decode >=10 frames, clean teardown,
   - assert INTEROP_PASS: frames >= 10 and exit 0; echo INTEROP_PASS/INTEROP_FAIL markers.
2. `scripts/bench-latency.sh` — same session in release mode, >=200 frames, collect erd-client --stats-json, print p50/p95/p99/max, write bench-results.json; print side-by-side Moonlight table if a moonlight CLI exists locally, else print 'MOONLIGHT_BASELINE: not installed — our numbers only' and exit 0.
3. RUN BOTH. Iterate on failures (minimal Rust fixes in clients/rust allowed — note every fix) until vm-interop.sh prints INTEROP_PASS and bench-latency.sh writes bench-results.json.

SCOPE: scripts + minimal fixes to clients/rust only; no Sources/ changes; no git commit; VM-only execution for E2E/bench.

VERIFY: save logs to /tmp/vm-interop.log and /tmp/bench.log; report must include tail of vm-interop log showing INTEROP_PASS and the bench-results.json content.

STOP WHEN: both scripts pass with captured evidence.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Add packaging configs and a macOS/Linux/Windows CI build matrix for the Rust client/host.

Work in /Users/indo/code/project/EclipticRD-Rewrite. First read: .github/workflows/rust-client.yml, clients/rust/Cargo.toml, clients/rust/erd-host/Cargo.toml (features), clients/rust/erd-decode/Cargo.toml (FFmpeg dep). Cross targets x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu and x86_64-pc-windows-gnu already build locally.

DELIVERABLE:
1. New .github/workflows/rust-matrix.yml: matrix [{os: macos-latest, target: aarch64-apple-darwin, features: <real macos feature name from erd-host Cargo.toml>}, {os: ubuntu-latest, target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, features: <real linux feature>}, {os: windows-latest, target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc, features: <real windows feature>}]. Each job: checkout, rustup target add, install ffmpeg deps (apt on ubuntu; documented best-effort on windows), cargo build -p erd-host --features <feat> --release, cargo test --workspace where feasible, upload binary artifacts. Use the REAL feature names found in erd-host/Cargo.toml.
2. clients/rust/packaging/: (a) nsis/EclipticRD.nsi bundling erd-host.exe + erd-client.exe + README-FFMPEG.md listing exactly which FFmpeg DLLs (avcodec/avformat/avutil/swscale/swresample, license notes) must sit beside the Windows exe; (b) install.sh for linux dropping binaries to /usr/local/bin and checking ffmpeg presence.

SCOPE: workflow YAML + packaging configs only; NO changes to clients/rust crate sources; no Sources/ changes; no git commit.

VERIFY: YAML parses (python3 -c 'import yaml,sys; yaml.safe_load(open(".github/workflows/rust-matrix.yml"))' or actionlint if available); `cargo metadata --no-deps` sanity in clients/rust. Include outputs in report.

STOP WHEN: YAML valid, packaging files present, report includes verification outputs.

TASK: Run all six success-criterion gates yourself, capture evidence, and produce the final review report with a verdict.

Work in /Users/indo/code/project/EclipticRD-Rewrite. Do not trust prior claims — re-run everything.

Gates in order:
1. clippy: cd clients/rust && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings 2>&1 | tee /tmp/gate-clippy.log — exit 0, zero warnings. Mechanical warning fixes allowed if needed (note each).
2. tests: cargo test --workspace 2>&1 | tee /tmp/gate-test.log — all green; report total passed.
3. VM E2E: bash scripts/vm-interop.sh 2>&1 | tee /tmp/gate-e2e.log — must contain INTEROP_PASS. If missing/failing due to absent functionality, report FAIL with reason; do NOT implement features yourself.
4. bench: bash scripts/bench-latency.sh 2>&1 | tee /tmp/gate-bench.log — must produce p50/p99; report numbers.
5. Swift regression: git diff --quiet -- Sources/ && echo CLEAN (must be CLEAN); build+run TestCLI per AGENTS.md commands expecting 38/38; xcodebuild -scheme EclipticRDLogicTests -destination 'platform=macOS' test expecting SUCCEEDED.
6. Write docs/rust-migration-review.md: per-gate PASS/FAIL with evidence paths and key numbers, plus a code-quality section (module layout, API hygiene, perf risks) after reading the clients/rust crates. Verdict APPROVED only if gates 1-5 pass.

SCOPE: verification + mechanical clippy fixes + the review doc; no new features; no Sources/ changes; no git commit.

VERIFY: report must contain the verdict line, per-gate status, evidence file paths, total test count, and bench p50/p99.

STOP WHEN: all six gates executed and the report written with a verdict.
